036public class GenerateSquaresProcessor {
037
038    /**
039     * Processes an experiment to generate square regions for each recording, compute attributes,
040     * and compile data tables for all squares and tracks. The method applies geometric segmentation,
041     * assigns tracks to generated squares, and calculates both square-level and recording-level attributes.
042     * Finally, it writes compiled results to the file system.
043     *
044     * @param project        the project containing configurations and experiment data
045     * @param experimentName the name of the experiment to process
046     */
047    public static void generateSquaresForExperiment(Project project, String experimentName) throws IOException {
048
049        GenerateSquaresConfig generateSquaresConfig = project.getGenerateSquaresConfig();
050        LocalDateTime         start                 = LocalDateTime.now();
051
052        // ── LOAD ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
053        PaintLogger.debugf("Loading Experiment '%s'", experimentName);
054
055        Experiment experiment = loadExperiment(
056                project.getProjectRootPath(),
057                experimentName,
058                false,   // Don't load Squares
059                true     // But do load Tracks
060        );
061
062        if (experiment == null) {
063            PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to load experiment: %s", experimentName);
064            return;
065        }
066
067        PaintLogger.infof("Starting processing experiment '%s'", experimentName);
068
069        Path experimentPath = project.getProjectRootPath()
070                                     .resolve(experiment.getExperimentName());
071
072        // ── COMPUTE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
073        // Everything scientific happens here, in memory. It reads nothing and writes
074        // nothing, so it can be tested without a project directory.
075        if (!SquareGenerationService.computeExperiment(experiment, generateSquaresConfig, experimentPath)) {
076            return;  // cancelled; the service has already said why
077        }
078
079        Duration duration = Duration.between(start, LocalDateTime.now());
080        PaintLogger.infof("Finished processing experiment '%s' in %s",
081                          experimentName, formatDuration(duration));
082        PaintLogger.blankline();
083
084        if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
085            PaintLogger.infof("Cancelled before writing output for %s", experimentName);
086            return;
087        }
088
089        // ── WRITE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
090        writeSquares(experimentPath, compileAllSquares(experiment));
091        writeRecordings(experimentPath, experiment.getRecordings());
092        writeTracks(experimentPath, compileAllTracks(experiment).sortOn(RECORDING_NAME, TRACK_ID));
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * Segments a single recording into square regions based on configuration.
097     *
098     * @param recording             the recording for which squares are to be generated
099     * @param generateSquaresConfig the configuration specifying the number of squares and related parameters
100     * @return a list of generated {@link Square} objects
101     */
102    public static List<Square> generateSquaresForRecording(Recording recording,
103            GenerateSquaresConfig generateSquaresConfig) {
104
105        // Total number of squares per recording, and the side of the grid that holds them.
106        int numberOfSquaresInRecording = generateSquaresConfig.getNumberOfSquaresInRecording();
107        int gridSize                   = generateSquaresConfig.getGridSize();
108
109        List<Square> squares      = new ArrayList<>();
110        double       squareWidth  = IMAGE_WIDTH  / gridSize;
111        double       squareHeight = IMAGE_HEIGHT / gridSize;
112
113        int squareNumber = 0;
114        for (int rowNumber = 0; rowNumber < gridSize; rowNumber++) {
115            for (int columnNumber = 0; columnNumber < gridSize; columnNumber++) {
116                double X0 = columnNumber * squareWidth;
117                double Y0 = rowNumber    * squareHeight;
118                double X1 = (columnNumber + 1) * squareWidth;
119                double Y1 = (rowNumber    + 1) * squareHeight;
120
121                squares.add(new Square(
122                        recording.getRecordingName() + '-' + squareNumber,
123                        recording.getExperimentName(),
124                        recording.getRecordingName(),
125                        squareNumber,
126                        rowNumber,
127                        columnNumber,
128                        X0,
129                        Y0,
130                        X1,
131                        Y1
132                ));
133
134                squareNumber++;
135            }
136        }
137        return squares;
138    }
139
140    /**
141     * Assigns tracks to the predefined square regions of a recording.
142     * It processes the tracks table of the recording, assigns each track to the relevant square,
143     * updates the square attributes, and compiles a complete tracks table for the recording.
144     *
145     * @param recording             the {@code Recording} instance containing track and square data.
146     *                              The method modifies this object by assigning tracks to the corresponding squares
147     *                              and updating their track-related attributes.
148     * @param generateSquaresConfig the configuration specifying the number of squares and related parameters
149     */
150    public static void assignTracksToSquares(Recording recording, GenerateSquaresConfig generateSquaresConfig) throws IOException {
151
152        Table tracksOfRecording   = recording.getTracksTable();
153        Table recordingTrackTable = newEmptyTrackTable();
154
155        int numberOfSquaresInRecording = generateSquaresConfig.getNumberOfSquaresInRecording();
156        int gridSize                   = generateSquaresConfig.getGridSize();
157
158        int incrementalTrackCount = 0;
159
160        PaintLogger.debugf("Assigning tracks to squares (%d total tracks)",
161                           tracksOfRecording.rowCount());
162
163        // ------------------------------------------------------------------
164        // DEBUG CSV SETUP (developer diagnostic; off unless explicitly enabled)
165        // ------------------------------------------------------------------
166        // Enable per run with -Dpaint.debug.dumpTrackAssignmentCsv=true (same convention as
167        // the regression gate's -Dpaint.* switches). Deliberately NOT a configuration key:
168        // it is not a user option, and a config entry could silently linger switched on in
169        // a project. Read at call time, so it is never frozen at class-load.
170        final boolean dumpTrackAssignmentCsv = Boolean.getBoolean("paint.debug.dumpTrackAssignmentCsv");
171
172        Path debugCsvPath = null;
173
174        if (dumpTrackAssignmentCsv) {
175            Path debugDirPath = Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home")).resolve("Downloads").resolve("Debug");
176            Files.createDirectories(debugDirPath);
177            debugCsvPath = debugDirPath.resolve("all_square_tracks.csv");
178
179            // Write header once
180            Files.write(
181                    debugCsvPath,
182                    "RecordingName,Square,TrackId,X,Y,Duration,MaxSpeed,MedianSpeed,Displacement,Row,Col\n".getBytes(),
183                    StandardOpenOption.CREATE
184            );
185        }
186        // ------------------------------------------------------------------
187
188        // We optimize track assignment by calculating the square index for each track directly.
189        // O(N_tracks) instead of O(N_squares * N_tracks).
190
191        List<Track> allTracks = trackTableToList(tracksOfRecording);
192        Map<Integer, List<Track>> tracksBySquare = new HashMap<>();
193
194        double squareWidth  = IMAGE_WIDTH  / gridSize;
195        double squareHeight = IMAGE_HEIGHT / gridSize;
196
197        for (Track track : allTracks) {
198            double tx = track.getTrackXLocation();
199            double ty = track.getTrackYLocation();
200
201            int col = (int) (tx / squareWidth);
202            int row = (int) (ty / squareHeight);
203
204            // Boundary handling (ensure it doesn't exceed grid dimensions)
205            if (col >= gridSize) {
206                col = gridSize - 1;
207            }
208            if (row >= gridSize) {
209                row = gridSize - 1;
210            }
211            if (col < 0) {
212                col = 0;
213            }
214            if (row < 0) {
215                row = 0;
216            }
217
218            int squareIndex = row * gridSize + col;
219            tracksBySquare.computeIfAbsent(squareIndex, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(track);
220        }
221
222        int labelNumber = 0;
223        for (Square square : recording.getSquaresOfRecording()) {
224            int squareIndex = square.getSquareNumber();
225            List<Track> tracksInSquare = tracksBySquare.getOrDefault(squareIndex, Collections.emptyList());
226
227            incrementalTrackCount += tracksInSquare.size();
228
229            // Update the fields on each Track
230            for (Track track : tracksInSquare) {
231                track.setSquareNumber(squareIndex);
232                track.setLabelNumber(labelNumber);
233            }
234
235            Table updatedSquareTracks = trackListToTable(tracksInSquare);
236            recordingTrackTable.append(updatedSquareTracks);
237
238            // Update the square
239            square.setTracksList(tracksInSquare);
240            square.setTracksTable(updatedSquareTracks);
241            square.setNumberOfTracks(tracksInSquare.size());
242
243            // ------------------------------------------------------------------
244            // 🔥 DEBUG CSV APPEND (only when flag enabled)
245            // ------------------------------------------------------------------
246            if (dumpTrackAssignmentCsv && debugCsvPath != null) {
247                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
248                for (Track track : tracksInSquare) {
249                    sb.append(String.format(
250                            "%s,%d,%s,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%d,%d%n",
251                            square.getRecordingName(),
252                            squareIndex,
253                            track.getTrackId(),
254                            track.getTrackXLocation(),
255                            track.getTrackYLocation(),
256                            track.getTrackDuration(),
257                            track.getTrackMaxSpeed(),
258                            track.getTrackMedianSpeed(),
259                            track.getTrackDisplacement(),
260                            square.getRowNumber(),
261                            square.getColNumber()
262                    ));
263                }
264                Files.write(debugCsvPath, sb.toString().getBytes(), StandardOpenOption.APPEND);
265            }
266            // ------------------------------------------------------------------
267
268            labelNumber++;
269        }
270
271        recording.setTracksTable(recordingTrackTable);
272
273        PaintLogger.debugf("assignTracksToSquare - number of tracks assigned: %d; in recording: %d",
274                           incrementalTrackCount,
275                           tracksOfRecording.rowCount());
276
277        PaintLogger.debugf("✅ Total %d tracks assigned to %d squares.",
278                           recordingTrackTable.rowCount(),
279                           recording.getSquaresOfRecording().size());
280    }
281
282
283    /**
284     * Compiles all square data from the recordings in the specified experiment into a single table.
285     * The method iterates through each recording in the experiment, retrieves its square data,
286     * and appends it to a cumulative table. If a recording does not have square data available,
287     * an error is logged.
288     *
289     * @param experiment the experiment containing recordings whose square data is to be combined
290     * @return a {@code Table} containing the aggregated square data from all recordings in the experiment,
291     *         or an empty table if no square data exists
292     */
293    private static Table compileAllSquares(Experiment experiment) {
294        Table          allSquaresTable  = newEmptySquareTable();
295
296        for (Recording recording : experiment.getRecordings()) {
297            Table table = squareListToTable(recording.getSquaresOfRecording());
298            if (table != null) {
299                appendSquareTableInPlace(allSquaresTable, table);
300            } else {
301                PaintLogger.errorf("compileAllSquares - squares table does not exist for '%s'",
302                                   recording.getRecordingName());
303            }
304        }
305        return allSquaresTable;
306    }
307
308    /**
309     * Compiles all track data from the recordings in the specified experiment into a single table.
310     * The method iterates through each recording in the experiment, retrieves its track data,
311     * and appends it to an aggregate table. If a recording does not have track data available,
312     * an error is logged.
313     *
314     * @param experiment the experiment containing recordings whose track data is to be combined
315     * @return a {@code Table} containing the aggregated track data from all recordings in the experiment,
316     *         or an empty table if no track data exists
317     */
318    private static Table compileAllTracks(Experiment experiment) {
319        Table allTracksTable = newEmptyTrackTable();
320
321        for (Recording recording : experiment.getRecordings()) {
322            PaintLogger.debugf("Compiling tracks for experiment '%s' - recording '%s'",
323                               experiment.getExperimentName(),
324                               recording.getRecordingName());
325
326            Table table = recording.getTracksTable();
327            if (table != null) {
328                appendTrackTableInPlace(allTracksTable, table);
329            } else {
330                PaintLogger.errorf("compileAllTracks - tracks table does not exist for '%s'",
331                                   recording.getRecordingName());
332            }
333        }
334        PaintLogger.debugf("");
335        return allTracksTable;
336    }
337}
